tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i

dbang chog bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ sangs rgyas rdo rje bde ba che/ khrag 'thung dpal gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan la btud nas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bri bar bya/ /'dir ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i man ngag/lugs 'di'i khrid tshul kun gyi sngon du 'gro ba/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang gi cho ga ni/ rnam pa gnyis te ras bris la brten pa dang*/ rdul tshon la brten pa'o/ /de la dang po'i dbang du byas nas/ lhag gnas dang dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi bya ba gsum las/ dang po la sngon 'gro gtor ma sum+bha sa bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrī zhes byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho nas/ dṛ sh+ya ho 'i bar gyi mgron rnams bkug oṃ kha khā man chad lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /srin po'i= 'byung po'i= sha za'i= smyo byed= brjed byed= ma mo'i= de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ dam can khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi/ /las la bsrung ba dam pa dang*/ /yul phyogs 'di dang sbyin bdag dang*/ /slob ma la yang shis par mdzod/ /gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang pa'i/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams gang yin pa/ /gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di long la/ /da lta nyid du gzhan du dengs/ /ci te 'gro bar mi byed na/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen khros pa'i bkas/ /mtshon cha 'bar ba'i sprin spros nas/ / lus sems rdul du brlag ta re/ / zhes gtor ma phyir dor la mtshams bcad/ de nas mchod pa zhig bshams la/ gnas dang yo byad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang du hūṃ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du chud pa'i/

bh+ruṃ las gnas khang gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams las byung zhing*/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos*/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bzang zhing gya nom pa/ yul dus chad pa med par yongs su khyab cing*/ rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung*/ byed las rang gzhan mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pas/ phyi nang thams cad du gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhūpe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai be t+ya/ shap+ta/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra s+phā ra ṇa khaṃ/ rol mos byin 'bebs zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe ta pra tsa li te/ pradz+nya pa ra mi ta/ na da sam+bha be ta badz+ra dharma hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ? hūṃ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas bdag bskyed ni/ skyabs 'gro nas/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar yan chad/ sgrub thabs bzhin du bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ gtor ma gnyis kyang bshams te/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ rol mo byin 'bebs mi dgos/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad/ gcig tu 'dus te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ skad cig gis phyi rol dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/

dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal he ru ka zhes pa nas/ 'khod par gyur/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar/ mchod bstod gtor bsngo rnams bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ sang nyin dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub stsol pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ rgyas pa la dga' na phyis kyi lag len ltar/ bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa mchog/ rigs sngags rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ / dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ / bka' drin snang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya phyir stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang*/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge can/ / bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa nyer sbyor bas/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar 'byon par mdzad par rigs/ / zhes kyang lan gsum gsol ba btab/ /yig brgya lan gsum/ gang yang bdag blo sogs bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ muḥ zhes dbyings su gshegs su gsol/ lha lhag par gnas pa'i don no/ /bum pa gnyis spyi dang mthun par bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/

lto ba ldir zhing*/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul bcings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ zhes pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan gyi bar/ bdag skyed dang 'dra ba las/ rang nyid ces sogs kyi tshig dor ro/ /de nas bum bzlas ni/ yab yum gyi nye snying dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags rnams ci 'grub tu bzla/ a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sngags kyang nyer gcig la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs/ bum pa'i mchod pa sangs sbyangs byin rlabs byas la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ bum nang gi lha rjes chags kyi mes yongs su zhu te byang chub kyi sems su gyur zhes brjod/ ci ste las bum logs su sgrub par 'dod na/ snga ma'i bzlas pa song mtshams su/ las bum gyi nang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ skad cig gis bskyed nas/ sum+bha 'i sngags ci nus su bzlas/ mchod pa man chad phyogs gcig tu mdzad/ mchod yon dang gzungs thag phyogs so sor byed pa'am/ snga phyir spo ba'i srol kyang yod/ 'on kyang 'di la las bum gzhung las ma bshad cing nges par dgos pa ma yin no/ /bum pa lha gnas so/ /slob ma rnams la sngon 'gro'i bya ba rnams skabs 'dir byed pa/ slob ma lhag gnas kyi don yin cing*/ lhag por bya ba ni/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa 'bul ba yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu'i nang gi gsang ba bsgrags pa dang ye shes dbab pa dang nangs par dgos pas skabs 'dir mi mdzad bsam pa 'chos pa dang*/ skyabs sems dang*/ spro bskyed pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa'i gsol btab dang*/ gnang ba sbyin pa dang*/ rtog pa bsdu pa dang*/ yan lag lnga pa dang*/

sdom pa 'bogs pa rnams song ba'i rjes su/ nang mchod dang dri bzang bsres pa'i thig les slob ma'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum brjod de byin gyis brlabs la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku rdo rje rnam snang gi rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs te mgrin par thim/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te snying gar thim par mos mdzod/ ces bya/ 'di ni sngon 'gro dgu par byed cing*/ bcu pa ni gzengs bstod pa ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ / zhes pa nas/ des kyang 'di la dga' bar gyis/ / zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de ltar na mdor len gyi dbang du byas pa'i sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu po de dag ni/ slob ma lhag gnas so/ /dgu pa dang bcu pa'i bar du/ so shing*/ 'khyor chu/ bsrung skud/ ku sha rnams ster ba'i lag len kyang 'ga' zhig la snang ba spyir mi 'gal yang*/ gzhung na med pas nges par dgos pa ma yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa mchod pa 'bul ba/ bdag nyid 'jug pa/ slob ma dbang bskur te bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu'i bar/ gong lhag gnas kyi skabs bzhin du bya/ de nas mdun skyed kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ mchod pa bzang po dang*/ gtor ma zlum gtor gnyis sam/ thod gzugs dar mtshon sna lngas brgyan pa gang rung bya/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ bsrung 'khor rdo rje'i phyag gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re mda'i drwa ba me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/

bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bh+ruṃ las gzhal med khang chen po/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang*/ pha gu dang drwa phyed dang*/ rin po che dang mda' yab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang rnga yab la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchod pa'i sprin du mas gang ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang*/ de'i steng du rdo rje'i thal gdung gnyis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis nye bar brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad dang*/ de dag tu gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad dang*/ zhing skyong ba brgyad dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung dang*/ sprin dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten rnams brgyad brgyad dang bcas pa/ 'byung po dang*/ srin po dang*/ sha za dang*/ ro langs dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams rgyu ba/ ro dang keng rus dang bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs pas yongs su gang ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba dang zhes pa nas/ bcas pa'o/ /de'i steng du/ rang nyid gnas par gyur/ bdag nyid hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs ka nas maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ rnams spros pa te/ phyogs bzhir 'khod/ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ bzhi spro ste/ mtshams bzhir 'khod pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar gyi 'dab ma la nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim/ bar 'dir lha so so'i snying po ci 'grub tu bzlas pa'i mthar/

lha drug po re re'i sngags kyi mthar/ he ru ka'i yig brgya sbyar ba lan gsum gsum gyis brtan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ bde mchog sgyu 'phrul 'khor lo'i rol pa las/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje ar+gha'i rgyun/ / kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho rab spel bas/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i 'khor lo sdom gyur cig/oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de'i tshig rkang gnyis par/ zhabs kyi pad+ma'i gdung sel rdo rje'i chu/ / zhes dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi tshab tu pā d+yaṃ sbyar te chu gnyis so/ / oṃ bzang zhing dge ba'i me tog ni/ /gtsang zhing gtsang ma'i gnas las skyes/ / bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi /rdo rje nyi ma pad+mar phyung*/ /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid mchog/oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ hūṃ/ /dri yis rgyas pa lha yi rdzas/ /nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di/ /bdag gi sogs tshig rkang gnyis gong bzhin/ rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min cing*/ /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yi/ /nges par bsregs pa de yi sogs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /dhū pe/ srin po 'joms shing gtsang byed la/ /mun pa sel byed dge ba 'di/ /bdag gis sogs/ yi ge hūṃ las yang dag byung*/ /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /dī paṃ/ gtsang dag skye gnas las skyes pa/ /dge ba'i dri bzang dam pa 'di/ /bdag gi sogs/ bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*/ /de nyid kyis kyang byug pa ni/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /gan+dhe/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong*/ /sngags kyi zhal zas mchog 'di dag/bdag gi sogs/ 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag brten/

/de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya/ /nai bi t+ya/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs*/ / rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal tshim byed pa'i/ / sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig/rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyar/ /zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung*/ /rnal 'byor pa yi gzhom med sgra/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ /ghan+ṭer ṇi sogs dang rol chen bya/ nang mchod gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ /rdo rje btsun mo dpal gyi ni gu ma/ /mkhas grub chen po khyud po rnal 'byor la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rmog lcog mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus dang*/ /dbon ston spyan ras gzigs dbang skyer sgang pa/ / thog rdugs grub chen gnyan ston ri gong bar/ /rnam dag= 'gro ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas ston pa dang*/ /gtsang ma shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum pa'i zhabs/ khyung po gsum par byon pa'i tshul mgon la/ /rnam dag= bya bral ri khrod dbang phyug ras chen dang*/ /mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar po rin rgyal ba/ /

mnyam med chen po sangs rgyas dpal bzang la/ /rnam dag= grub chen chos rje nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ /rgya sgom sbas pa'i rnal 'byor legs rgyal ba/ / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dam pa'i rjer/ rnam dag= 'chi med dbang po mchog gzigs lha dbang grags/ /mkhas mchog byang chub thugs mnga' rdo rings dbon/ /rgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ rnam dag= 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' 'gro lā ma khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang*/ / gzugs can ma sogs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /rnam dag= myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs mgon re ma tī/ /k+ṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*/ /ṭāk+ki rā dza bdud mgon ṭak+shad la/ rnam dag= phyogs bdag zhing skyong klu yi dbang po dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dur khrod gnas pa'i tshogs/ /gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag ma lus la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa lan bdun/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ 'dir ni thog ma dbus tha med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ / ces brjod cing mnyam par bzhag /de nas bstod pa ni/ oṃ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug chen po ni/ / bskal pa chen po'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i cod pan can/ /mche ba gtsigs pa drag po 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /gzi brjid ldan pa stong phrag phyag gis ni/ /dgra sta zhags gdengs mdung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga/bsnams shing stag gi lpags pa'i na bza' 'dzin/ /dud kha mun nag chen po'i sku la 'dud/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ba te bī ri shā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kalpa ag+ni san+ni pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ oṃ dang hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshungs par sbyar la/ dza ṭa mu ku ṭoṭ+ka ṭa ya/ daṃ ṣ+ta ka ra lo gra bī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/

sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya/ pa ra shu pa sho d+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dha ri ṇi/ byā gh+ra dzi nām+ba ra dha rā ya/ mahā dhu mrān+dha ka ra ba pu ṣā ya/ zhes yab kyi rkang brgyad dang*/ oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags mo ni/ /gzhan gyi mi thub 'jig rten gsum yum rig ma ni/ / dbang phyug 'byung po'i 'jigs pa kun sel rdo rje che/ /rdo rje'i gdan ma mi pham dbang mdzad gzhan mi rgyal/ /spyan 'phrul dug skem drag mo khro mo mche gtsigs ma/ /skrag byed gsod byed 'joms byed rnal rgyal gzhan las rgyal/ / rmugs byed rmongs byed rengs byed rdo rje phag mo ni/ /rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang mo mkha' 'gror 'dud/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bha ga ba te badz+ra bā rā hi baṃ/ ār+ya pā ra dzi te trai lo kya mā te mahā bid+ya shwa ri/ sar+b+ba bhu ta bha ya bā he mahā badz+re badz+ra sa ne a dzi te a pa ra dzi te ba sh+yaṃ ka rī nai tra bh+ra ma ṇi/ sho kha ṇi ro ṣa ṇi krodha ni ka ra li nī/ tra sa nī ma ra ṇī pra bhe da nī a pa ra dza ya/ bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam bha ni mo hā ni/ badz+ra bā rā hi mahā yo ki nī kā me shwa rī kha ge zhes pa la rkang pa'i re re'i mgor/ oṃ na mo dang tha mar hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sbyar ba yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ gzhan yang*/ ye shes lnga ldan ngo bo nyid/ /rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po ste/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus he ru ka /bde mchog dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas rigs kyi dkyil 'khor kun/ /mnyam nyid gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku/ /mkha' khams shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor kun/ / gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /chu khams rnam dag snying rje'i dngos/ /mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las kyi rigs kyi= gcig tu/ rlung khams rnam dag btang snyoms dngos/ /lā ma'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi=

gcig tu/ me khams rnam dag dga' ba'i dngos/ /dum skyes ma la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rdo rje rigs kyi= gcig tu/ sa khams rnam dag byams pa'i dngos/ / gzugs can ma la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi byin rlabs pa/ /gzungs ma rnams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang*/ / pad+ma'i snod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang*/ /byang chub phyogs kyis rnam par brgyan/ /lha rnams bzhugs pa'i gdan dang bcas/ / rtag pa'i rang bzhin khyod la 'dud/ /rnam shes brgyad po rnam dag pa/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi gnas/ /dur khrod brgyad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis/ /bdud tshogs ma lus zil gnon pa/ /mi phyed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /chos nyid shes rab gru gsum gnas/ /ye shes lha tshogs khams lngas brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus sprul pa'i gzhi/ /bde chen de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ /rgyud lnga 'gro ba rnam dag nas/ /rnam lnga ye shes go 'phangs ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mthus thob shog / ces pas kyang bstod/ mchod bstod de tsam ni nges par bya dgos la/ rgyas pa la spro na/ gos zung dang*/ rim bcu drug dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun la sogs pa mchod pa'i rnam grangs ji snyed yod pa kun/ gzhan nas kha bskang de 'dir sbyar bas rung la/ 'dir ni yig rnying du gtogs pa'i mchod 'bul rgyas la/ nyog pa rnams kyi spros pa spangs te/ yid brtan thub nges pa rnams bsdus te bkod pa yin no/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ phal cher sgrub thabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ ye shes lha la gtor ma phul ba'i rjes thogs de nyid la/ gtor chog ltar myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po la gtor ma 'bul/ de rjes/ oṃ kha kha sogs kyis 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin no/

/gsum pa ni sngon 'gro dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas rgyun bshags ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du rtsal dang yi rang gang*/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /ma lus de dag bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*/ /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog/de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog/'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*/ /sems can sdug bsngal mang po gzir las sgrol/ / zhes lan gsum/ de nas sdom bzung ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /ji tsam dus nas bzung nas su/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su/ /nam zhig byang chub snying po la/ /yongs su gnas kyi bar dag tu/ /bdag gi byang chub mchog gi sems/ /ma lus par ni bskyed par bgyi/ / ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pas/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsam ste gzung bar bgyi/

/nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ / pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen pa la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyid/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces lan gsum/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ lan gnyis kyis mig dar dang me tog blang*/ nyungs dkar gtor zhing sum+bha'i sngags kyi bgegs bskrad/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bsrung ba bya/ rang gi snying khar he nag po rgyu dang bral ba/ mgrin par ru dmar pa tshogs dang bral ba/ dpral bar ka dkar po gang du yang mi gnas pa/ lte bar shrī ser po gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su gyur/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ zhes stong pa nyid du sems bskyed/ de nas/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug/oṃ na maḥte hūṃ/ na mo me hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes phyag 'tshal du gzhug/de nas gsang ba bsgrags pa ni/ gnas gsum du dri bzang gi thig le byas la/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+t+wa u pa da ya mi*/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/

'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ khyod kyi spyi bor gzhag pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sku ru khyod 'grub cing*/ /mi phyed ye shes thob par 'gyur/ / snying gar bzhag la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smra na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral ste gshegs/ /bdud rtsi lnga'i nang mchod blud la/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /ye shes bdud rtsis chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka hūṃ/ yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng nas gzung ste bu khyod kyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi/ /nga yi ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par gyis/ /gal te nga la brnyas pa na/ / sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pa yin/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas/ / dmyal ba chen por gyur ta re/ / bcu pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes mchog/sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gtso bos bdag la stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur gsal ba'i/ rkang mthil gnyis kyi 'og tu/ yi ge dzhaiṃḥdamar po bskul bar byed pa po/ gsang bar aḥdamar po gsung rdo rje/ snying gar hūṃ nag po thugs rdo rje/ spyi bor haṃ dkar po sku rdo rje/ snying gi nang du 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum mtshon gang ba rnams 'khod par gyur/ slob dpon nam mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gsung sku rdo rje rnams 'od zer mthing dmar dkar gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ gnas gsum gyi hū?ṃ āḥha rnams la thim/ dzhaiṃḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rkang ba'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus nang gi yi ge gsum bskul bas/

de rnams las 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang zhing*/ lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab/ yang slob dpon nam/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te/ sangs rgyas tham cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi snying gar sib sib thim par gyur/ spos dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ yi ge bdun pa mang du bzlas shing*/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha mahā krodha a be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes pa bzlas pas ye shes dbab/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra lan gnyis kyi brtan par byas la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sems can khyod/ /'di ni so sor bzung bar gyis/ / zhes me tog spyi bor bcings/ he ru ka dpal dang khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni rtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūṃ a/ de ni phyi'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog/'od kyi gong bu gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa yab rkyang gi rnam par gyur/ yang sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres te/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i thig le'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo gdod nas grub pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hūṃ zhes bya bas gsang ba nas phyir spros te/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi shar sgo'i nang du pad nyi la mkhod par gyur/ slob ma la dbang skur ba'i skabs yin na/ de nas skabs 'dir/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag sgrub thabs dang mdun bskyed kyi skabs bzhin lha ngo bstan par bya la/

bdag 'jug gi skabs ni/ phyi dkyil mthong bar mos pa tsam gyi chog go /de nas/ rang bzhin gyi ni dag pa'i bdag/ lus ni rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang mo'i gnas/ /dkyil 'khor la ni bu khyod ltos/ / zhes nang gi dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med kyi sku la gnas pa'i rtsa rnams mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ khams rnams dpa' bo'i rang bzhin du nges par gyis shig / de ni nang gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /dngos gzhi las/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bsam gyis mi khyab chos kyi snod/ /bdag la dbang ni bskur du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba 'debs/ de la dang po chu dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka / slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug/thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mi bskyod pa/ sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas/ g.yas rkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ hūṃ zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ phyi rol tu dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/ byang chub kyi sems kyi cha gcig ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa de nyid thogs te dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/
/de bzhin bdag gi sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/

gtso bo yab yum gyi nye snying dang*/ lha mo bzhi'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ri bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus thams cad bde bas gang*/ snying ga'i 'khor lo brtan par byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan/ de ltar chu dbang thob pas/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag te/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas so/ / zhes so/ /'di man chad cod pan gyi dbang sogs ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ ye shes mngon du byas so zhes pa'i bar/ chu dbang gi skabs de nyid kyi rigs 'dres pa las/ khyad par ni/ cod pan gyi dbang la/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka zhes dang*/ gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa zhes dang*/ rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang zhes pa nas/ sems kyi cha gcig dbu rgyan du gyur lha rnams kyi dbu rgyan de nyid thogs te dbang bskur/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra ta staṃ a haṃ zhes dbu rgyan bcings/ oṃ rat+na sam+bha ba a bhī ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes bum pa'i chus zhes dang*/ lte ba'i 'khor lo brtan par zhes dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan/ de ltar cod pan gyi dbang thob zhes dang*/ tshor ba'i phung po zhes dang*/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas so/ / zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gi mtshan pa/ 'od dpag me dmar po/ pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ sems kyi cha gcig rdo rje 'gyur/ lha rnams kyis rdo rje de nyid thogs te dbang bskur bar gyur/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/

/de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ / sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long*/ /slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ oṃ pad+ma dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'du shes kyi phung po/ sor rtog ye shes zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /de bzhin du dril bu'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ cha gcig khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ don yod grub pa/ sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang*/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu/ cha gcig dril bur gyur/ dril bu de nyid thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya/ zhes dril bu btang*/ oṃ karma bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo/ / don yod grub pas dril bus dbang thob/ 'du byed kyi phung po/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes zhal 'don pa spo/ de bzhin du ming gi dbang ni/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bu gnyis ka /cha gcig bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ gyi mtshan pa /rnam par snang mdzad/ dkar po 'khor lo dang*/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ /cha gcig rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bur gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bu de nyid thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ badz+ra nā ma abhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal/ gsang ba'i ming btags/ oṃ bud+dha bha baṃ abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ ming gi dbang thob pas/ gzugs kyi phung po/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zhes 'don pa spo/ de ltar dbang rnam pa lnga po de thob pas phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga/ khams lnga yum lnga/ dbang po dang yul rnams sems dpa' dang sems ma/ rnam par dag pa'i lus kyi cha rnams khro bo dang*/ khro mo'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs pa yin no/ /de nas sngags kyi dbang ni/ bdag nyid 'khor lo bde mchog yab rkyang gi rnam pa tsan du gyur/

snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ/ thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying gar hūṃ gi mtha' bskor du 'khod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs lan gsum gsum/ de nas me tog 'bul/ ster byed bzhin par/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ / rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ yang rdo rje'i dbang gi skabs bzhin du chu dbang gi skabs la 'don pa spos te/ dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka = cha gcig = hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa = rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po = rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo = cha gcig rdo rjer gyur/ rdo rje de nyid thogs te/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /he ru ka dpal rtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya/ tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ/ dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ rdo rje rtul zhugs kyi dbang thob/ ye shes kyi phung po/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas so/ / spyod pa'i rtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ bdag nyid hūṃ las byung ba'i he ru ka 'khor lo sdom par gyur/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ḍā ma ru thod pa tshangs skud rnams gtad/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te lhung bzed sbyin/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang par gyis/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lha'i sku/ ḍā ma ru stong pa nyid kyi sgra/ thod pa bde ba chen po/ tshangs pa'i skud pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo nyid do/

/ lung bstan cing gzengs bstod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dang slob dpon dbyer ma mchis pa/ dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i skur gyur pas lung bstan cing*/ gzengs bstod par gyur/ 'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan yin/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod bton/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur bhu ba swa/ gsang ba'i ming yid kyis dran par bya/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu khyod zhugs so/ / de nas phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur gyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ /dam pa bdag la stsal du gsol/ / lan gsum/ yang gong bzhin phal cher chu dbang la 'don pa sgyur te/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dang po'i rdo rje dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu gnyis ka = gyur pa'i cha gcig hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan par = rdo rje 'chang chen he ru ka /sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo/ sems kyi cha gcig cha gnyis su gyur te/ dang po'i rdo rje dang*/ dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bur gyur/ rdo rje de nyid thogs te/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu sgrub phyir rdo rje long*/ / rdo rje gsor zhing snying gar gtad la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ / kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag/bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ dril bu de nyid thogs te/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/

/byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ / lan gsum du dkrol te/ g.yon pa la brten nas/ aḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag/ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog/srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /rang nyid skad cig gis dpal he ru ka /phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bus yang dag par 'khyud pa/ yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgya rab tu bsgrags/ /shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ badz+ra bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po myong*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur*/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*/ /de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bo 'dod pa lnga spyad do/ /bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyis dngos/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi gnas/ /de phyir bdag gi thams cad bya/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchog/brten cing 'brel bar 'byung chos can/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med byos/ / zhes pa ni rjes gnang ngo*/ / de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang bskur thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ sprul sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas/ gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/

/mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum rjes chags kyi snyom par zhugs pas/ bde bas sgras sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te/ zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i/ bde ba'i rten kun+da lta bu dang rdul gyi dwangs ma rdo rje dang pad+ma las mthe bong dang ming med kyi yang dag par blangs te/ rang gi lce thog tu bzhag/'di de dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga ldan pa'i ros rtogs byed/ /bde ba gang de myang bar byos/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ a ho mahā su khaṃ/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems myangs pas/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gang*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags/ bde ba'i ye shes brjod bral rgyud la skyes par gyur/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /lam gtum mo dang sgyu lus sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku'i rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pas/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ / lan gsum/ phyag rgya lo bcu gnyis nang nyi shu'i bar gang yang rung ba/ lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa bdag la gtad/ lha mo 'di ni khyad par che/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/

/rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya long*/ /bu yis bla med mchod par gyis/ /lha mo des kyang bshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen brten pa la dga'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i gnas su tsum+bha ni/ khyod ni spro ba yin nam ci/ / zhes dris/ de la sogs pa'i dam tshig kun/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ / zhes lan btab pas/ de dgyes nas phyogs kyi gos can gsang rtsa rgyas pa'i pad+ma mtshon bzhin du/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /ci te cho ga bzhin brten na/ /sangs rgyas snyems pa la sogs pa/ / bya ba thams cad pad+mar byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu zhugs/ /pad+ma bhañtsa ho/ bdag dang rig ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum gyi skur rdzogs pa la/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje oṃ las skyes pa'i nor bu/ bu gar phaṭa kyi yongs su bkag pa/ hriḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma āḥlas skyes pa'i ze 'bru rtse mor as mtshan pa/ thabs shes snyoms 'jug rjes su chags pa'i rkyen gyis/ byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pa'i khyad dga'/ gsang bar byon pas g.yo med du brtan par byas pa ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o/ /slar yang gyen du gshegs par gyur te mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas/ don dam rang rig lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong zung 'jug mngon du byas/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ lam gzhan lus shes rab sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyi/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bdag la bka' drin skyabs du gsol/

/ lan gsum/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /sems nyid spros pa thams cad bral ba/ dmigs pa med pa'i sgyu lus dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zung 'jug tu gdod ma nas rang shar ba ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes te/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ / lan gsum dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin btang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /bdag 'jug rkyang pa la ni de tsam gyis chog la/ slob ma la dbang bskur na/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ / bden pa de yis mgon dag la/ khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu te/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /

de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog / ces lan gsum gyis bden stobs brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog/snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis kyang gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ / bzhi pa ni/ gong du ji skad bshad pa'i bdag 'jug gi don de rnams/ slob ma la 'bog pa yin te/ bdag 'jug gi tshig don legs par byed na/ lag len mthong ba tsam gyis shes par 'gyur bas logs su ma bris so/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba rnams rdzogs pa na/ slar yang mchod pa gsar du bshams pa'am kha gso/ /gong bzhin byin gyi sa brlabs/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyi phyi mchod phul/ snying po drug pa'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ thugs brtse ba chen por mdzad de/ bar chad zhi ba dang dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ zhes pa dang gzhan yang 'dod don gsol ba ci rigs par btab/ yig brgya mang du bzla/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol smon lam/ bkra shis bsngo ba rnams sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin byed dgos pa las/ mgron gshegs gsol gyi mthar/ dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'dod pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi phyogs la brten pa ni/ sa chog dang*/ thig tshon byin gyis brlabs nas/ thig gdab cing dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ rdul tshon gshegs su gsol ba la sogs pa dgos te/ rgyas pa la dga' na/ rgyu sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga chen mor bshad zin pa las shes par bya zhing*/

da lta lag len byed pa nyung bas 'dir ni ma bris la/ snying po bsdus pa'i yig chung zhig 'bri bar yang 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di la lha lhag gnas rgyas pa dang*/ ras bris kyi skabs sa'i lha mo'i cho ga ni mi dgos te/ 'di nyid kyi rang lugs gong du bshad pa kho na'i 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ni gu'i lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga 'di la/ dkyil chog rgyas pa rgya gzhung ma gtogs bod yig dag gsal cha tshang ba zhig cher mi snang la/ cho ga'i yan lag 'ga' re bris 'dug na'ang*/ shin tu nyog par mngon cing*/ rje grol mchog gis mdzad pa 'di yang*/ zhu ba po'i blo ngo dang bstun pa'i rang lugs las phyir phyogs pa mang du snang bas/ 'dir dag cing gsal la gzhan dang ma 'dres par rang lugs ma tshang ba med cing bzung bde bar bkod pa yin no// //rnal 'byor can la nyer mkho bas/ /dkyil chog spros pa nyung ngu 'di/ /bshad las dge ba gang thob des/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sa thob shog/ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang chog bzhugs/ - PAGE 212 -- PAGE 187 -- PAGE 186 -
